headline: Underwriting gains offset by MediaAlpha stake markdown
summary_short: White Mountains posted a Q1 2026 net loss of $27.2 million (vs. $33.9 million net income a year ago) as a $65 million unrealized MediaAlpha markdown outweighed an improved 91% combined ratio at Ark; book value per share fell to $2,169.66, down about 1% including dividends.
summary_long: Revenue fell 10% y/y to $517.8M as Ark swung to a $33M investment loss (from a $30M gain) and the year-ago quarter included now-divested Bamboo revenue. Pre-tax income fell to a $25.5M loss from $72.4M as Ark's combined ratio improved to 91% (from 94%, on lower catastrophe losses) but a $65M unrealized MediaAlpha markdown drove Other Operations to an $80M pre-tax loss. Kudu grew adjusted EBITDA to $16.9M and posted 12% trailing-12-month ROE; HG Global grew premiums 24%; Distinguished's managed premiums rose 7% y/y. Ex-MediaAlpha, the investment portfolio returned 1.0%. Book value per share ended at $2,169.66, down 0.8% for the quarter including a $1.00 dividend. No formal forward guidance was issued.
